svg.text: Hibou architecture — ingestion → intelligence → gate → outputs
Editable in diagrams.net / VS Code (draw.io model embedded in this SVG). Companion prose: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md · decisions: docs/adr/
SDLC — where hibou sits in the lifecycle
new advisory or KEV listing re-gates open PRs — no CI re-run
hibou server — one Go binary (API + workers + background loops)
CI pipelines — hibou CLI / upload action
+ commit provenance: head / merge / base SHA
CVE Program records — blobless clone, 15 min diff
HTTP edge (chi) — REST /api/v1 · embedded Vue SPA · webhook receiver
forge IP allowlist · rate limiting · HMAC · sessions & API tokens
RBAC mirrored from the forge (permissionsync — no manual membership)
raw artifact bytes — never stored in PostgreSQL
parsers: sbom · sarif · coverage · testresults · distro
components · findings · coverage · tests · code refs
components ↔ advisories: providers + locally authored ranges
gitleaks clones · attempts back off 5·n² minutes
severity · CWEs · malware flag · fixed versions
retention · stale scan/pending · token expiry · update check
gate reconcile · PID-1 reaps orphaned git processes
tags → releases · `hibou release deploy` records rollouts
Delta & quality gate — per PR, advisory-scan-readiness guarded
PR snapshot vs provenance-aware base · VEX / acceptance filtered
pr_checks (+ claims base SHA) · resolved fingerprints
advisory locks (leader election) · durable job claims
provenance: head — tested as merge X onto base Y
findings & triage drawer — exploited badge, waiver friction
compare / PR diff · dependencies · org views
findings · repos · gates exposed as tools
for Claude & other MCP agents: query, triage, explain
same RBAC and audit trail as humans
